job.job_description:
We are looking for a proactive and technically strong Support Engineer to provide production and application support for modern cloud-native applications built on ReactJS, FastAPI/Django, and Azure services. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in monitoring, troubleshooting, incident management, root cause analysis, and operational support across frontend, backend, APIs, search, and cloud infrastructure components.

This role requires strong analytical skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to work closely with development, DevOps, and product teams to ensure high application availability, performance, and reliability.

Required Technical Skills

Application Platform Support

Strong experience in application support / production support / site support for cloud-hosted applications.
Good understanding of frontend support for ReactJS applications.
Experience supporting Python-based APIs, preferably FastAPI and Django.
Knowledge of REST APIs, request/response lifecycle, API authentication, and debugging tools such as Postman.

Azure Services

Hands-on experience with:
Azure Static Web Apps
Azure App Service
Azure Container Apps
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Log Analytics
Application Insights
Ability to monitor application health, analyze telemetry, and troubleshoot deployment/runtime issues in Azure.

Search / AI Services

Experience supporting solutions built with:
Azure AI Search
Azure AI Foundry (or Azure OpenAI / AI service integrations)
Familiarity with troubleshooting search indexing, query issues, search relevance, and AI workflow/service connectivity.

Data Caching

Working knowledge of:
Redis
PostgreSQL
Ability to troubleshoot query performance, connection issues, caching behavior, and data-related problems.

Monitoring Troubleshooting

Strong experience in:
Log analysis
Incident triaging
Root cause analysis (RCA)
Alert handling
Performance troubleshooting
Familiar with dashboards, telemetry, metrics, and distributed application monitoring.
